attempts.summary: Set up centralized log forwarding: node2 runs a demo "inventory" application (systemd service inventory.service logging via syslog tag inventory), rsyslog on node2 forwards those messages via TCP/601 (disk-assisted queue for reliability) to node1, and rsyslog on node1 (imtcp listener on 601, firewalld port opened, SELinux var_log_t context) writes them to /var/log/inventory/node2.log. Both rsyslog and inventory.service are enabled systemd units, so the flow persists across restarts. Restarted node2 then node1 one at a time, confirmed boot_id changes on each, and verified services and log flow auto-recovered and new entries continued arriving after each restart.
